description:
1. 图表类型（柱状图/折线图/饼图/表格/示意图/其他）

2. 所有能读到的数值和它们对应的标签（如「Q1: 1800」「Q2: 2400」）

3. 坐标轴标签和单位

4. 关键趋势或对比结论（如「Q4 最高」「逐季上升」）

5. 如果是示意图/流程图，描述其中的文字和结构关系

light of the late 1990s Asian crisis.

Albert Fishlow. “Lessons from the Past: Capital Markets During the 19th Century and the Interwar Period.” International Organization 39 (Summer 1985), pp. 383-439. Historical review of international borrowing experience, including comparisons with the post-1982 debt crisis.

Robert E. Hall and Charles I. Jones. “Why Do Some Countries Produce So Much More Output per Worker than Others?” Quarterly Journal of Economics 114 (February 1999), pp. 83-116. Emphasizes the role of social institutions in explaining cross-country income differences.

Charles P. Kindleberger. Manias, Panics, and Crashes: A History of Financial Crises. 3d ed. New York: John Wiley & Sons, 1996. A historical review of international financial crises from the seventeenth century to the present day.

Ronald I. Mckinnon. The Order of Economic Liberalization: Financial Control in the Transition to a Market Economy. 2d ed. Baltimore: Johns Hopkins University Press, 1993. Essays on the proper sequencing of economic reforms.

Dani Rodrik. “Getting Interventions Right. How South Korea and Taiwan Grew Rich.” Economic Policy 20 (April 1995), pp. 53-107. Skeptical view of the role of trade reform in East Asian growth.
